reports.title: TG Therapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full-Year Revenue Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance Update
section: •Raises full year 2026 target total global revenue to approximately $1 billion
•Raises full year 2026 target BRIUMVI U.S. net product revenue to approximately $915-$920 million

•Reaffirms full year 2026 target operating expense (R&D and SG&A excluding non-cash compensation) guidance, of approximately $450 - $500 million including expenses associated with the subcutaneous BRIUMVI manufacturing costs and secondary manufacturer start-up costs

desk.headline: Revenue up 61% to $260m, beat; full-year revenue guidance raised to about $1bn

other.label: Net income
other.change: vs $390.9m incl. a one-off tax gain

results: Total revenue rose 61% to $260m, driven by US sales of the MS drug BRIUMVI, up about 52% to $232.6m.
Other revenue jumped to $19.9m from $2.4m, mostly licence and milestone income from its partner outside the US.
Diluted EPS was $0.35; last year's $2.43 included a one-off tax gain of about $365m, so the two are not comparable.
Operating income almost tripled to $85.9m even as research and selling costs rose.
About $100m of shares were bought back in Q3, taking the total to $300m, about 6% of shares outstanding.

guidance.summary: TG lifted its 2026 revenue targets for both total sales and US BRIUMVI sales, and kept its spending guide unchanged.

points: Management pointed to a strong fourth quarter as the basis for the higher revenue target.
A simpler single-infusion starting dose for IV BRIUMVI could be approved around mid-2027.
An under-the-skin version, with an auto-injector, is aimed at a possible 2028 launch; Phase 3 data are due around year-end.
Management called its pricing contracts sustainable and expects little impact from changes in the 340B drug-discount segment.
call.source: Press release (Exhibit 99.1) and call coverage: Seeking Alpha earnings call insights (automated summary), 9 Nov 2026

watch: Topline Phase 3 data for subcutaneous BRIUMVI, expected late 2026 or Q1 2027.
Whether Q4 delivers the step-up needed to reach about $1bn for the year.
Regulatory progress on the simplified IV starting dose.
